metadata.title: Standards Alignment Database
metadata.description: Multi-system curriculum standards mapped to all 11 program Learning Labs. Used by Agent 1 curriculum alignment mode.
metadata.ai_knowledge_cutoff: GPT-5.2, March 4 2026. Standards reflect best available knowledge at that date only.
metadata.accuracy_warning: Standards change. This file must be reviewed annually before each academic year. See maintenance_schedule for update instructions. Do not cite specific standard codes to teachers without verifying current adoption status in their state or country.

maintenance_schedule.frequency: Annual — review each August before the new academic year starts
maintenance_schedule.owner: Program data scientist or designated educator reviewer

US: NGSS: Stable since 2013 but STATE ADOPTION VARIES. Texas uses TEKS, Virginia uses SOLs — check state_standards_note column per teacher location before citing codes.
CCSS ELA and Math: Stable but politically contested in some states — verify state adoption.
AP Course Descriptions: Updated by College Board ANNUALLY each fall. Always check apcentral.collegeboard.org for current CED before citing AP unit hooks.
CSTA K-12 CS Standards: Last major update 2017, minor revisions ongoing.
ISTE Student Standards: Updated 2016 — check iste.org for any revisions.
IB: IB uses frameworks and criteria, not numbered codes — alignment is more stable than US code-based standards.
MYP Subject Guides: Updated approx every 5-7 years. Estimated next MYP review cycle ~2027.
DP ESS Guide: Last updated 2015 (first assessment 2017). Check ibo.org for any new edition.
DP Geography: Check current syllabus year at ibo.org.
PYP: Major enhancement 2018 — verify any PYP content against current PYP framework document.
UK: COVERS ENGLAND ONLY. Scotland=CfE, Wales=Curriculum for Wales, NI=separate. Do not apply UK table to non-England schools.
National Curriculum programmes of study: Updated approx every 3-5 years. Check gov.uk/national-curriculum.
GCSE Specs: Rolling ~5-year update cycle per exam board. Always ask teacher which board (AQA/OCR/Edexcel/WJEC) before citing spec-specific content.
A Level Specs: Same rolling cycle. Check individual board websites for current spec year.
RSE and computing curriculum under review as of 2025 — check DfE for updates.
Cambridge: Syllabuses updated on rolling 5-year cycle per subject. Verify current syllabus year at cambridgeinternational.org before citing content points.
Global Perspectives framework is relatively stable — research, collaboration, communication skills.
Cambridge Primary/Lower Secondary frameworks updated 2020-2022 — verify if working with older teacher materials.

update_process: 1. Check each official_source URL above for any published updates
2. Edit the relevant CSV file in documents/standards/ (one file per system)
3. Increment version number (e.g. 1.0.0 to 1.1.0) and update generated_date in this JSON
4. Add an entry to the change_log array below
5. Run: python3 tests/test_standards_alignment.py to verify all mappings intact
6. Commit with: git commit -m 'standards: annual review YYYY-MM'
7. Notify the program team that standards database has been updated

change_log.author: GPT-5.2 + Abi Kambanis
change_log.notes: Initial generation. Covers US full K-12 progression including AP, IB (PYP/MYP/DP), UK England (KS2-A Level), Cambridge International (Primary through AS/A Level). Knowledge cutoff March 4 2026.

routing.description: Routing patterns for Agent 1 teacher curriculum alignment. Maps natural teacher inputs to standards tables and likely learning labs.

patterns.routing_notes: Use US table; emphasize NGSS MS/ES + CCSS ELA K-8 + CCSS Math domains for 3-5.
Use NGSS MS/ES and keep math domains + CCSS ELA K-8 for literacy tasks.
Prioritize NGSS HS life science PEs and AP course fit if requested.
Use AP Course Fit + AP Unit/Skill Hooks when available; keep NGSS HS as supportive justification.
Frame around population, migration, land use, development, and human-environment interaction.
Emphasize datasets, distributions, trend/association, inference framing, and communication.
Use PYP Themes; keep language simple; include action as learner agency.
Emphasize design cycle: identify need, criteria, prototype, test/iterate; tie to global contexts.
Use DP subject group fit and explicitly suggest TOK/EE/CAS pathways.
Keep links broad to National Curriculum strands; emphasize enquiry and vocabulary development.
Use GCSE hazards/coasts/urban & resource management case-study framing; highlight evaluation/extended writing.
Frame as externalities, market failure, policy instruments, cost-benefit, distributional impacts.
Use Cambridge command-term language: investigate, evaluate, explain; emphasize data handling and extended responses.
Route to Cross-curricular/GP hooks: research question, perspectives, source evaluation, presentation/action.
Ask a single follow-up: which AP course? If not possible, offer top labs with broad AP fit and let teacher choose.
If subject unspecified, prioritize Geography/Science-friendly labs and propose options; invite teacher to pick topic.

step_by_step: 1. Match teacher input text against routing.patterns using regex_any matching
2. If confidence >= 0.75: proceed with matched curriculum_system and stage
3. If confidence < 0.75 OR no match: use fallback_script to ask one clarifying question
4. Load correct standards table from standards[curriculum_system]
5. Filter table rows by subject and grade/stage using pattern filters
7. Always end with one concrete next step the teacher can take
never_do: Never cite NGSS codes to a UK, IB, or Cambridge teacher
Never cite IB criteria numbers to a US public school teacher
Never assume NGSS adoption — check state_standards_note column before citing NGSS to any US teacher
Never cite specific GCSE spec content without first asking which exam board (AQA/OCR/Edexcel/WJEC)
Never apply the UK table to Scottish, Welsh, or Northern Irish schools
Never present standards alignment as exhaustive — always say 'here are the strongest connections'
Never cite AP Unit/Skill Hooks without noting that AP Course Descriptions update annually
agent1_routing_instructions.fallback_script: I want to make sure I give you the most relevant standards connections. Could you tell me: (1) what curriculum system your school follows — for example US state standards, IB, UK National Curriculum, or Cambridge International? And (2) what subject and year or grade level you teach?
agent1_routing_instructions.low_confidence_script: I have a couple of possible matches for what you described — are you teaching [option A] or [option B]? That will help me pull exactly the right standards alignment for you.
agent1_routing_instructions.state_adoption_fallback: I want to flag that not all US states have adopted NGSS — could you confirm which state you teach in? That way I can make sure the standards codes I suggest are the ones your school actually uses.

US.description: United States national subject-specific standards. Full K-12 progression including elementary (K-5), middle (6-8), high school (9-12), and AP courses.
US.critical_warning: The US has NO single unified curriculum. Standards are subject-specific. NGSS = science only. CCSS = ELA and Math only. C3 = social studies only. Never use NGSS codes for a social studies, arts, or math teacher.
US.state_adoption_warning: Texas uses TEKS (not NGSS). Virginia uses SOLs (not NGSS). Several other states have modified or rejected NGSS/CCSS. Always check the state_standards_note column and confirm teacher's state before citing specific codes.
US.ap_warning: AP Course Descriptions are updated annually by College Board each fall. Always direct teacher to apcentral.collegeboard.org for the current CED.

IB.description: International Baccalaureate: PYP (ages 3-12), MYP (11-16), DP (16-19). Approximately 5,600 schools in 160+ countries. English, French, and Spanish medium instruction.
IB.critical_warning: IB does NOT use numbered standard codes like NGSS. Alignment is to programme frameworks, global contexts, key concepts, and assessment criteria. Never invent IB standard code numbers.
IB.update_note: IB subject guides updated on rolling cycles. Direct teacher to ibo.org for their specific subject guide and current edition year.

UK.critical_warning: ENGLAND ONLY. Scotland (Curriculum for Excellence), Wales (Curriculum for Wales), and Northern Ireland all have separate and distinct curricula. Do not apply this table to non-English schools.
UK.exam_board_warning: GCSE and A Level content varies meaningfully between AQA, OCR, Edexcel, and WJEC. Always ask which exam board before citing specification-level content.
